question: In which five-year plan was the 'food, work, and productivity' slogan used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The slogan 'food, work, and productivity' was used during the **Seventh Five-Year Plan** of India.
 
• This plan was implemented during the period from **1985 to 1990**.
 
• The main focus was on increasing agricultural production, employment, and productivity in various sectors.
 
• It aimed to achieve self-sufficiency in food grains and increase employment opportunities to reduce poverty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans of India**

 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs. These plans aimed at economic development and were formulated by the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The **First Five-Year Plan** (1951-1956) focused on agriculture and energy.
 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan** (1956-1961) aimed at the rapid industrialization of the country.
 
• The **Third Five-Year Plan** (1961-1966) focused on agriculture and improving production of wheat.
 
• The **Fourth Five-Year Plan** (1969-1974) aimed at growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance.
 
• The **Fifth Five-Year Plan** (1974-1979) focused on poverty alleviation and achieving self-reliance.
 
• The **Sixth Five-Year Plan** (1980-1985) emphasized the elimination of poverty and technological self-reliance.
 
• The **Seventh Five-Year Plan** (1985-1990) focused on "food, work, and productivity."
 
• The **Eighth Five-Year Plan** (1992-1997) aimed at improving the quality of life, generating employment, and reducing inequality.
 
• The **Ninth Five-Year Plan** (1997-2002) aimed at achieving a rapid and sustainable growth rate.
 
• The **Tenth Five-Year Plan** (2002-2007) focused on reducing poverty and achieving a growth rate of 8% per annum.
 
• The **Eleventh Five-Year Plan** (2007-2012) aimed at inclusive growth.
 
• The **Twelfth Five-Year Plan** (2012-2017) focused on faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth.
 
 
 
• **Planning Commission of India**
 
 
• The Planning Commission was an institution in the Government of India, which formulated India's Five-Year Plans, among other functions.
 
• It was established in March 1950 by an executive resolution of the Government of India, on the recommendation of the Planning Commission's Report.
 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by the **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) in 2015.
